import Foundation.IBMMultichannelCompletion
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal Topology DirectSum
noncomputable section
open OperatorDerivativeRewrite.Foundation
open IBMTimeAveragedObservable IBMPredictableLpDictionary IBMFullPredictableIntegral
open IBMPredictableCovarianceMeasure IBMMultichannelCompletion
attribute [local instance] componentAdd componentGroup componentModule componentZeroDec
local instance : DecidableEq IBMFixedStochasticFamily.basisSet := Classical.decEq _

example {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : ι → JointL2) (i : ι) (H : PredictableL2 (F i)) :
    completedIntegral F (embed F (DirectSum.lof ℝ ι _ i H)) = integral (F i) H ∧
      ‖embed F (DirectSum.lof ℝ ι _ i H)‖ = ‖H‖ := by
  have he := (completedIntegral_embed F _).trans (rawIntegral_single F i H)
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  rw [← (completedIntegral F).norm_map, he, integral_norm]

example {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : ι → JointL2) (u v : Raw F) :
    inner ℝ (embed F u) (embed F v) = gram F u v ∧
      (embed F u = embed F v ↔ rawIntegral F u = rawIntegral F v) := by
  constructor
  · rw [← (completedIntegral F).inner_map_map, completedIntegral_embed,
      completedIntegral_embed, gram_actual]
  · constructor
    · intro h
      simpa only [completedIntegral_embed] using congrArg (completedIntegral F) h
    · intro h
      apply (completedIntegral F).injective
      simpa only [completedIntegral_embed] using h

example : ∃ (F : Bool → JointL2) (u : Raw F),
    u ≠ 0 ∧ embed F u = 0 ∧ gram F u u = 0 := by
  let F : Bool → JointL2 := fun b => if b then IBMDeterministicRangeObstruction.observed 1
    else -IBMDeterministicRangeObstruction.observed 1
  let Hp : PredictableL2 (F true) := dictionary (F true) IBMActualMixedEnergyObstruction.unitPresentation
  let Hm : PredictableL2 (F false) := dictionary (F false) IBMActualMixedEnergyObstruction.unitPresentation
  let u : Raw F := DirectSum.lof ℝ Bool _ true Hp + DirectSum.lof ℝ Bool _ false Hm
  have he : rawIntegral F u = 0 := by
    rw [show rawIntegral F u = integral (F true) Hp+integral (F false) Hm by
      simp only [u, map_add, rawIntegral_single]]
    simp only [Hp, Hm, integral_dictionary]
    exact IBMActualMixedEnergyObstruction.actual_two_channel_cancellation.1
  have hn : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun v : Raw F => v true) hz
    have hp : Hp = 0 := by
      change ((DirectSum.lof ℝ Bool (fun b => PredictableL2 (F b)) true Hp : Raw F) true) +
        ((DirectSum.lof ℝ Bool (fun b => PredictableL2 (F b)) false Hm : Raw F) true) = 0 at hcoord
      simpa [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_apply] using hcoord
    have hzero := congrArg (integral (F true)) hp
    rw [map_zero] at hzero
    have hpos : integral (F true) Hp = IBMDeterministicRangeObstruction.observed 1 :=
      (integral_dictionary _ _).trans ((IBMActualMixedEnergyObstruction.unitPresentation_ring _).trans
        IBMActualMixedEnergyObstruction.observed_unit_cell)
    exact IBMDeterministicRangeObstruction.observed_one_ne_zero (hpos.symm.trans hzero)
  refine ⟨F, u, hn, ?_, (null_iff_zero_energy F u).mp he⟩
  apply (completedIntegral F).injective
  rw [completedIntegral_embed, map_zero, he]

example {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : ι → JointL2) (s : Finset ι)
    (H : ∀ i, PredictableL2 (F i)) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, embed F (DirectSum.lof ℝ ι _ i (H i))‖^2 =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, ∫ᵛ p, H i p*H j p ∂<•covariance (F i) (F j) :=
  completed_partial_energy F s H

example (t : ℝ≥0) : ∃ z, completedIntegral fixedFamily z =
    (IBMTimeAveragedObservable.intrinsicCurve t : JointL2) := by
  refine ⟨fixedHilbertEquiv.symm (IBMFixedStochasticFamily.remainder
    (IBMTimeAveragedObservable.intrinsicCurve t)), ?_⟩
  have hz : IBMObservedTerminalMartingale.channelClass (intrinsicCurve t : JointL2) 0 = 0 :=
    IBMObservedInitialGerm.initial_channel_zero t
  simpa only [hz, sub_zero] using
    fixed_reconstruction (IBMTimeAveragedObservable.intrinsicCurve t)

example (f : IntrinsicSpace) : ∃! z,
    completedIntegral fixedFamily z = (f : JointL2)-IBMObservedTerminalMartingale.channelClass (f : JointL2) 0 := by
  refine ⟨fixedHilbertEquiv.symm (IBMFixedStochasticFamily.remainder f), fixed_reconstruction f, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact (completedIntegral fixedFamily).injective (hz.trans (fixed_reconstruction f).symm)

example {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : ι → JointL2) (H : ∀ i, PredictableL2 (F i))
    (hH : ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ s : Finset ι, ∀ t, Disjoint t s → finiteEnergy F t H < ε^2) :
    ∃ z : Completed F, HasSum (fun i => embed F (DirectSum.lof ℝ ι _ i (H i))) z ∧
      HasSum (fun i => integral (F i) (H i)) (completedIntegral F z) ∧
      Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => finiteEnergy F s H) atTop (𝓝 (‖z‖^2)) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hi⟩ := series_realization F H hH
  refine ⟨z, hz, hi, ?_⟩
  simpa only [completed_partial_energy, SummationFilter.unconditional] using hz.norm.pow 2

example {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (F : ι → JointL2) (z : Completed F)
    (g : JointL2) (hg : g ∈ IBMIntrinsicRightGerm.rightPast 0) :
    completedIntegral F z ∈ IntrinsicSpace ∧ inner ℝ g (completedIntegral F z) = 0 := by
  have hm := completed_mem_remainder F z
  refine ⟨hm.1, ?_⟩
  rw [real_inner_comm]
  exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal' _ _).mp hm.2 g hg
